name: Clarence
source:
Clarence is one of the orphans kidnapped by the Master. After a malfunction caused by sabotage, automatic locks on the orphans' romms stopped functioning, giving them a chance to escape. They regrouped and Clarence naturally took the lead in their group.
They support each other and try to find a way to save the other children who are being held prisoner.
